contract: one text file read from memory: one text per line

libass 0.17.5's ASS_SHAPING_SIMPLE over each line as one paragraph: FriBidi 1.0.17's levels with the case's base direction, fribidi_get_joining_types, fribidi_join_arabic and fribidi_shape with FRIBIDI_FLAGS_DEFAULT | FRIBIDI_FLAGS_ARABIC
per line: its length and the shaped code points; packets count lines and bytes code points
a line that does not parse is recorded as such; the file is read before each timed and memory operation
